name: IIITDM Cube Open 2018

venue.name: Indian Institute of Information Technology, Design & Manufacturing
venue.address: Indian Institute of Information Technology, Design & Manufacturing, Melakottaiyur Village, Off Vandalur-Kelambakkam road

information:
There is no on-spot registration.
Please bring your ID cards for identification at the college gate.

Participation limit is 120, so register as soon as possible.
Registration closes either on August 14, 2018, 11:59 PM IST or when registration count reaches 120 (whichever comes first)
[Click here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IIITDMCubeOpen2018/register) to register.
